name: r5-01-fixed
title: Round 5 @ 752f9eaf: F6, F8 and the reachable F5 cases now recover on the real stack
subtitle: Spring + MySQL + Hosted Harness + GreenMail + qwen channel managed-email. The Harness is SIGKILLed and restarted; the sender writes again at once.

panels.t:
## F8: Harness SIGKILL, mail to an attached thread
11:10:11 kill → Harness answers /health 2 s later
11:10:14 /inbound  !! 503 (generation mismatch)
11:10:17 /inbound  !! 503 managed_session_writer_conflict × 7
11:11:14 /inbound  ++ 200 admitted (lease lapsed, +63 s)
== lease 180 s run: × 10, admitted at +180 s, replied
++ 0 emails skipped across 9 Harness kills (34 writer 503s re-driven)
## F6: route Session closed while its reply is held
++ receipt 409 × 2 → "refused (409); it is dropped."
++ Bob's unrelated new thread answered in 8 s

panels.h: F5 text turn and files-profile Write
panels.t:
## text: "HOLD me T#t1" parked at the model, SIGKILL
++ Interrupted channel wake turn … was settled without a reply
++ follow-up t2 answered 10 s after admission
## Write: write_file parked (runtime worker SIGSTOPped)
11:16:10 model → write_file b.txt (no result yet)
11:16:27 Harness SIGKILL, back 11:16:29
++ load passes the gate after the writer lease (409s were F8)
++ worker resumed; the Broker proves the stop
++ Interrupted channel wake turn chin-e03e… was settled
++ follow-up answered 51 s after the kill
++ next request: dangling tool calls = []
++ runtime session RELEASED, Workspace lease freed

note: These are the paths the 09:21 review called unreachable (Write load gate) plus F6/F8; all three now hold end to end. Channel Sessions created by Spring always use hosted-workspace-files/1, so the Write case is the reachable tool case.

name: r5-02-shell-unknown
title: Latent (P2): a shell tool interrupted by a Harness restart is always UNKNOWN, and its dead turn then holds the Workspace mount
subtitle: Only reachable with hosted-workspace-shell/1, which Spring never assigns to a workspace Session today (ManagedAgentStore.java:422); this rig forces it with a DB trigger.

panels.h: Every real interruption ends UNKNOWN (4 runs)
panels.t:
## shell tool `sleep N` running, Harness SIGKILLed
-- tool finished during the downtime          → unknown
-- no restart: tool reaped 118 s after the kill → unknown
-- fast restart + follow-up at +2 s: tool killed
--   at the takeover (+63 s)                   → unknown
## each time
!! Interrupted channel wake turn … keeps its durable wait
!!   for the recovery fleet: Runtime execution outcome is unknown.
-- Monitor wake turn … needs recovery, not a re-drive.
-- follow-ups admitted, 0 model calls, 0 replies
-- operator turn via public API: failed (hosted_turn_failed)
== stopParkedRuntimeExecutions throws on status 'unknown';
== the Broker's reconcileExecution is never asked

## qwen_runtime_session
chin-4151… (dead turn)       READY      since 10:53:57
chin-33a0… (other thread)    ACQUIRING  since 11:01:50
chin-ad38… (files-profile    ACQUIRING  write_file)
## managed_workspace_execution_lease
holder = chin-4151…  mount_state = UNVERIFIED (no expiry)
## Harness
-- Hosted Harness turn … waits for the Workspace mount
--   held by another Session.
== every tool call of every Session in that Workspace
== queues behind the dead turn, with no timeout

note: Latent today because channel Sessions are files-profile only. If the shell profile is ever enabled for them, a routine Harness restart during a shell command would stop tool use for the entire Workspace.

name: r5-03-approval
title: P2: after a restart the approval can still be granted, but the approved turn never resumes
subtitle: QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_APPROVAL_MODE=default (the shipped default is yolo). Bob's write_file waits for approval when the Harness is SIGKILLed.

panels.h: Hold works, the decision is delivered
panels.t:
11:18:28 model → write_file c.txt
         action tool_approval_9e42… state=requested
11:19:00 Harness SIGKILL, back 11:19:01
11:19:06 POST …/actions/…/responses (allow)
         ++ 202 pending, admission_stage=java_durable
11:20:04 follow-up p2 admitted (after 7 × writer-lease 503)
++ Interrupted channel wake turn chin-1802… keeps its durable
++   wait for its approval; the Session stays usable.
11:20:13 Harness POST …/actions/…/resolve  ++ 200
== the 09:21 review's "resolve route blocked" is fixed

-- action list now empty (resolved: allow)
-- c.txt never written
-- 0 model calls since the restart
-- p2 and a later p3 admitted, 0 replies
11:23:18 p3 kicks the pump:
!! … keeps its durable wait for its approval (again)
== the checkpoint still reads await_action after the
== resolution, so the helper answers `held` forever;
== no recovery driver exists for channel Sessions

note: The approval is preserved and resolvable, which was the point of the held arm, but the continuation that should execute the approved tool and call the model never runs after a Harness restart.
